summary: Ship `.agentic/releases/unreleased/README.md` in the bundled template payload so greenfield `gh plate bootstrap --apply` satisfies the `agentic_releases` adoption check without a follow-up `import-payload`.
migration_impact: New greenfield bootstraps are `core_ready` for the releases layout immediately after bootstrap. Repos bootstrapped before this fix can still run `gh plate import-payload --apply` to seed the layout via the existing adoption seed.
agent_notes: Do not remove `_seed_releases_layout_if_missing` in import_payload; it backfills adopters who bootstrapped on older template payloads. After this change, import-payload may skip seeding when the payload README is already present.
